description: Verify that DHCPREQUEST 'secs' field equals the originating DHCPDISCOVER's 'secs' value (RFC 2131 §4.3.2 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The 'secs' field reports how long the client has been trying to acquire / renew. The REQUEST is part of the same attempt as the DISCOVER, so RFC 2131 §4.3.2 says secs must carry the same value — otherwise relay agents and servers can't reason about retry duration consistently.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER (secs = N) → harness snapshots N
2. Tester → DUT: DHCPOFFER
3. DUT → wire: DHCPREQUEST
   • secs == N   ← key check

[Pass condition]
REQUEST.secs equals the snapshotted DISCOVER.secs.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_discover / Fail_no_request — DORA missing
• Fail_request_secs_mismatch — REQUEST.secs differs from DISCOVER.secs

verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_request_secs_mismatch: DUT DHCPREQUEST secs mismatch with DISCOVER
